title: A Speculative Parallel DFA Membership Test for Multicore, SIMD and Cloud Computing Environments
relevance: Analyzes speculation overhead as a function of DFA properties and input characteristics. The convergence factor gamma varies with input content, motivating adaptive chunk sizing.

title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: simdjson processes the entire input uniformly. Adaptive chunk sizing could exploit the non-uniform structure of real JSON files to improve parallel throughput.

title: Scalable Structural Index Construction for JSON Analytics (Pison)
relevance: Pison's intra-record parallelism uses fixed-size partitioning. Adaptive sizing could improve load balance and reduce speculation overhead for records with non-uniform structure.
